name: mai-agent-hillclimb
description: Scaffolds and deploys MAI-powered hosted agents on Microsoft Foundry, measures a baseline, runs Agent Optimizer, calibrates endpoint/tool graders and guarded reinforcement fine-tuning, and verifies quality, latency, and cost. Use for hosted-agent onboarding, agent optimization, RFT experiment planning, checkpoint comparisons, and token-cost calculations for any use case.
